data.one_liner: Asset package providing Cupertino icon font for Flutter
data.what_it_does: It supplies the default set of Apple‑styled icons used by Cupertino widgets. The icons are delivered as a font asset that can be referenced via the CupertinoIcons class.
use_when: You are building a Cupertino‑style app and need the official icon set.
You want a lightweight, officially maintained icon source for iOS‑style UI.
avoid_when: You prefer Material icons or a custom icon set.
You need icons beyond the Cupertino repertoire.
weaknesses: Limited to Cupertino icon set only
